question: Which of the following statements regarding the microprocessor 8085 is NOT correct?

options.text: It has serial I/O control, which allows serial communication.
It has a mechanism by which it is possible to increase its interrupt handling capacity.
It can be used to implement three chip microcomputers with supporting I/O devices like IC 8155 and IC 8355.
It does not provide control signal (IO/M, RW, WR) to control the bus cycles, hence external bus controller is required.

solution:
The correct answer is __It does not provide control signal (IO/M, RW, WR) to control the bus cycles, hence external bus controller is required.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Microprocessor 8085__ is an 8-bit microprocessor developed by Intel.
 
• It provides serial I/O control, enabling serial communication.
 
• It has a mechanism to increase interrupt handling capacity through vectored interrupts.
 
• With supporting I/O devices like IC 8155 and IC 8355, it can be used to implement compact microcomputers.
 
• However, it provides control signals (IO/M, RW, WR) to manage bus cycles, eliminating the need for an external bus controller.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Interrupt Handling:**
 
 
• 8085 includes vectored and non-vectored interrupts.
 
• It has five interrupt lines: TRAP, RST7.5, RST6.5, RST5.5, and INTR.
 
 
 
• **Serial Communication:**
 
 
• 8085 supports serial communication through SID (Serial Input Data) and SOD (Serial Output Data) lines.
 
• These lines allow exchange of data between the microprocessor and peripheral devices.
 
 
 
• **Supporting ICs:**
 
 
• IC 8155 offers additional I/O ports and a timer.
 
• IC 8355 provides programmable memory and I/O ports.
